ai_summary: Ashoka Metcast Limited has appointed Mrs. Jhanvi Vikas Sethi as a Non-Executive Independent Director for a five-year term, effective August 12, 2026. This strategic addition significantly enhances the board's financial expertise and governance oversight, as Mrs. Sethi brings over two decades of extensive experience in financial markets and investment management. No material red flags are apparent in this regulatory filing, which demonstrates compliance with SEBI disclosure requirements.
